hypothesis: V26's small GRU plus pairwise ranking improved action rank correlation to0.0792 and produced positive0.5x net, but its absolute score was overconfident. Use the same causal GRU and pairwise ranking while decomposing the observed label into fill probability, conditional win probability, positive payoff magnitude and negative payoff magnitude. Compose expected net only from these causal heads, then apply the unchanged policy. This is a new learned outcome decomposition, not a post-hoc threshold filter.
selection: Fixed16 epochs, all3 seeds x11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed or fold selection and no threshold/portfolio tuning. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, net, coverage and fills. No live approval.
compute: Private free Kaggle T4x2 only for heavy training; local GTX1650 inference/replay/backtests. Do not mutate v19/v21/v22/v23/v25/v26 exports.
